title: Mario's DOE clearance delays and repression of his experience
place_text: US Department of Energy (Oak Ridge, Los Alamos)

tellings.quote: I I had to repress this because my first clearance took over 8 months to obtain

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who later worked at nuclear sites, says that around 1978 he had to push down the memory of what he describes as an abduction by aliens. The reason, he says, was that his first security clearance with the Department of Energy, for work at sites like Oak Ridge and Los Alamos, took more than eight months to come through. He tells Michels this from his own experience, suggesting that speaking up could have cost him his career.
